purpose_context: Open-packs still runs a Python copy of the charter's cross-pack rules because pack-check misses some faults that registration refuses and both accept some faults the operator now rules must be refused. This mission renames pack-check to pack-doctor (validate and remediate), makes registration and pack-doctor refuse unheld or undeclared preset ids and stale manifest hashes, adds the closure walk under --full, and adds a structured report and a manifest and canonical-form remediation, so open-packs can retire its Python rules.
purpose_tldr: One answer on every surface: pack-doctor and registration refuse the same pack faults, and pack-doctor can repair manifests.
